name: Eden's Ritter - Chapter 2 Cecily Gaiden ~Guou no Kuni no Inreiki Cecily~
original_name: エデンズリッター第２章セシリィ外伝～愚王の国の淫隷姫セシリィ～
source:
A visit to an allied kingdom marks the beginning of a lonely battle.

As the Great War of Lost Paradise shakes the world, Cecily learns that her mentor, the Wise King Barof, is on his deathbed. And so, Cecily travels to the Ildrize kingdom.

However, King Barof dies under mysterious circumstances, and Cecily is accused of his murder.

As Cecily sets out to investigate by herself to prove her innocence and save people from suffering, the conspiracy enveloping the kingdom closes in on her.

=======================================================

An Eden's Ritter side story set in Chapter 2, featuring Princess Cecily as the protagonist.

Falsely accused of murder in the allied kingdom of Ildrize, Cecily faces a conspiracy that threatens the entire kingdom.

This story depicts Cecily's belief in trusting and saving others, as well as her personal growth leading into Chapter 3.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1381071/]getchu[/url]]
translation:
造访同盟国的旅途，拉开了孤独战斗的序幕。

当动摇世界的失乐园大战愈演愈烈之际，塞西莉得知自己的恩师——贤王巴洛夫病危垂死。于是，塞西莉动身前往伊尔德莱兹王国。

然而，巴洛夫王却离奇驾崩，塞西莉更被冠上了弑君凶手的罪名。

为了洗清自己的冤屈、拯救饱受苦难的民众，塞西莉孤身一人展开调查，而笼罩整个王国的巨大阴谋也正向她步步逼近。

=======================================================

以第2章为舞台、由塞西莉公主担任主角的《伊甸骑士》外传故事。

在同盟国伊尔德莱兹蒙受弑君不白之冤的塞西莉，将直面足以动摇整个王国的阴谋。

本作描绘了塞西莉坚信他人、拯救苍生的信念，以及迈向第3章的成长历程。
